name: Noeud
description: Cortex de surveillance analysant en continu les communications adverses détectant les plans d'attaque avant leur exécution.

subject.archetype: Cyborg Surveillance Specialist - Neural-Linked Reconnaissance Unit

loadout.armor_outfit: Standardized matte black composite tactical exoskeleton with integrated neural interface ports, dark gray angular plating covering torso and limbs, reinforced cervical collar housing massive black data cables connecting to exposed spine, pale cadaveric flesh visible at neck joint, serial identification codes etched into shoulder plates, slim sensor pack mounted on upper back
loadout.arsenal: Integrated wrist-mounted electromagnetic pulse scanner, neural-linked targeting array glowing cold blue, compact signal disruption device holstered at hip, direct-cable interface ports at wrists and base of skull

attitude.behavior: Crouched combat stance with weight forward, left arm extended holding scanner device toward enemy position, right hand gripping hip weapon, head tilted scanning environment, body coiled tight and ready for rapid lateral movement, legs positioned for explosive acceleration
attitude.emotion: Empty hollow gaze behind glowing blue optical implants, absolutely expressionless face with visible neural scarring, cold calculated awareness, zero emotional response to destruction surrounding the unit

palette_names.name: Cold Neon Blue #00D4FF
palette_names.role: Neural implants, sensor arrays, and energy accents

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic rim lighting from electric storm in background, cold blue fill light from neural implants, orange spark light from damaged server towers, heavy volumetric fog with digital artifacts

camera.angle: Low angle dutch tilt, slightly behind and to the left of subject, 35mm equivalent focal length

scenography.setting: Collapsing cyber warfare zone interior, massive server rack towers toppling at sharp angles with sparking damage, floor covered in shattered holographic projection panels showing deteriorating code fragments and glitching enemy tactical displays, exposed cables and severed data conduits hanging from ceiling, industrial metal grating floor with accumulated debris and burnt circuit boards
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Violent electric storms rippling through infrastructure with visible energy arcs, intense digital glitch effects (DPI corruption, color banding, scan line artifacts) on all holographic elements, thick smoke with particle debris, emergency red warning lights pulsing through blue fog, crumbling digital fortifications visible as pixelating shield fragments
